about: Faults injected one at a time into the Example Bank answer (fixtures/rates-usdxts.json); each must be refused, by the plug-in's shape check or by core's checks (taxFxProblems), with the message given (a regular expression). `remove: true` deletes the field instead of setting it.

faults.name: a rate of 0
faults.message: rate 0 is not a finite number above 0

faults.name: a negative rate
faults.message: rate -149.25 is not a finite number above 0

faults.name: a publication stamp without a time of day
faults.message: publishedAt must be an instant with a time of day and a zone
